races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but TRIPLE TRADE scored in veterans company at Sandown last term and also made a winning return at Cheltenham last season so gets the nod from a yard well among the winners. races.verdict: Plenty in with a squeak but the vote goes to DEARG MOR , who shaped well and was a bit unlucky sent chasing after 11 weeks off when finishing a close third to Springboard earlier in the month. He can get the better of Potters Pal , who made a winning start in this sphere at Listowel last month and is his new trainer's first runner (successful amateur jockey). Harty Cup and Lanzhou can fight out minor honours. DEARG MOR (IRE) POTTERS PAL (FR) HARTY CUP (IRE)
